About this offer
Technic Jobs SA is a company specialized in the placement and recruitment of personnel
in the trades of Building Technology. Present in Geneva and Lausanne, it has been offering services in French-speaking Switzerland since 1998.
Qualified Electrician Mount (VAUD)
Your mission will be to:
- Perform readings of electrical drawings and diagrams
- Participate in renovation and construction projects
- Install low current and strong current electrical equipment
- Install cable paths, luminaires and appliances
- Perform various connections
- Working as a team and alone
For this position, we are looking for a candidate with:
- An electrical installer CFC or a European electricity diploma
- Knowledge of NIBT standards
- An experience in Switzerland in the field of electricity
If you meet this profile, please do not hesitate to send us your application. We look forward to receiving your application and meeting with you to discuss this exciting opportunity.
